5832.d: The chaos altar is a runecrafting altar located in Chaos Rune Temple, which is used to craft chaos runes from pure essence with Runecrafting skill.

gt.heading: Access
gt.text:
As with most other rune temples, it can be accessed via the Abyss without a talisman.

Players could enter the ruins with any of the following talismans or replacements:
• A chaos talisman
• An omni-talisman
• A chaos tiara
• An omni-tiara
• A wicked hood imbued with any of the above
• A chaos talisman staff
• An omni-talisman staff
• A full set of ethereal outfit (while such a wicked hood is in the bank or the backpack, but not in armour case)

Players can reach the ruins in any of the following ways:
• Break a chaos altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
• Use the portal in the Tunnel of Chaos to get to the chaos altar without travelling through the Wilderness. It places the player at the third level. From there, the player should go east and then clockwise to the west ladder to reach the fourth level. After that, they should head east to reach the altar.
